properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 3 at 4:09PM CST by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
At 409 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Bivens, or near Bon Weir, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Merryville, Singer, Bon Weir, Bancroft, Junction, and Bivens.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued November 3 at 11:40AM CST until November 3 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Shreveport LA
properties.description:
At 1140 AM CST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 6
miles south of Blanchard to 7 miles southeast of Stonewall, or along
a line from 6 miles northwest of Shreveport to 11 miles north of
Mansfield, moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Shreveport, Bossier City, Greenwood, Stonewall, Fosters, Keachi,
Longstreet, Forbing, Keithville, Frierson, Robson, Taylortown,
Kingston, Kickapoo, Gloster, Reeds Store, Barksdale Air Force Base
and Spring Ridge.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in Shreveport LA.
